UnitedHealth's net income for fiscal Q1 2026 (quarter ended March 31, 2026) was roughly $5.6 billion. This is my best estimate, not a figure I could confirm from the filing. It rests on a vague recollection of adjusted EPS of about $6.90, less roughly $0.80 per share of amortization and other adjustments. That gives GAAP EPS of around $6.1, and on about 905 million shares that is about $5.5 billion attributable to common shareholders. Net income including noncontrolling interests would be slightly higher, hence about $5.6 billion.
